messages.name: locked
messages.description: Lock for duration time if time >0, unlimited time if timer==0. During lock phase no other commands will be accepted or executed. Locking may be cleared with „unlock“

enum.label: delay
enum.description: Execute switching command after delay defined by timer

enum.label: duration
enum.description: Execute switching command immediately and switch back after duration defined by timer

enum.label: override
enum.description: Controller is override by another device
